{{Quote|Takin' the safety off!|Anonymous Rebel trooper|<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
'''Rebel troopers''', also known as '''Rebel soldiers''' and '''Rebel infantry''', were front-line [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends| Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|Declaration of a New Republic]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Rebel [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were organized into regular [[New Republic soldier/Legends|units]] of the [[New Republic Army]].

==History==
[[File:Rebel_trooper_starkiller.jpg|thumb|left|Rebel troopers with Starkiller in 1 BBY.]]

[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] came from all walks of life and joined up for many reasons.<ref name="BF guide">[[Star Wars Battlefront: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] defectors were not uncommon,<ref name="EG Warfare" /> and some clone troopers were known to have joined the Alliance.<ref name="Reb comic">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (comic series)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'' comic series]]</ref> From the [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farms]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to the marbled halls of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Rebel troopers hoped to shore up the struggling [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] in any way they could.

From the beginning of the Alliance in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]<ref name="TFU" /> and up until the formation of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Warfare" /> the Rebel troopers saw their organization transformed. What started out as countless local cells of loosely structured resistance groups, gradually turned into a galactic wide and well-trained [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] force.

The infantry forces saw action on many worlds throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], fighting with and against the native populations.<ref name="EAW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>

==Organization==
[[File:ToArms-TCGEoD.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Rebel troopers arm themselves for battle]]
Rebel troopers constitute the main element of the [[Alliance Army/Legends|Alliance Army]]. In the overall structure of the Alliance's military, the troopers fell under the jurisdiction of [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Forces]], under the ultimate command of [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]].<ref name="EG Warfare" /> Rebel troopers were organized into standard units of varying size, ranging from [[Squad/Legends|squads]] and up to the largest tactical units, the [[Division/Legends|divisions]]. Divisions were roughly equivalent to [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] Legions in manpower, but not necessarily in combat power.

Rebel troopers sometimes stood in contrast to the better trained and better equipped [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]]. Furthermore regular Rebel troopers were typically a few years younger and less experienced than their colleagues in the SpecForces. Nevertheless SpecForces was often dependant on the support of these troopers from the Sector Forces to complete their own battle objectives. Also the Rebel troopers served as a primary source of SpecForce recruitment. If a Rebel trooper had above average physical and mental abilities and was dedicated enough to the Alliance, he could be considered a SpecForce candidate.

Rebel troopers employed squad-level tactics and guerrilla warfare to to be effective against the Empire. They also deployed vehicles in hit-and-run missions.<ref name="BF guide" /> Squads were carried and deployed into battle aboard [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]].<ref name="EAW" />

==Uniforms and equipment==
[[File:Charge.jpg|thumb|left|Rebel heavy troopers, with reinforced rebel armor and helmets.]]
The task of supplying all Rebel troopers with standardized uniforms on a galactic scale was nearly impossible. Nevertheless the [[Alliance Army/Legends|Alliance Army]] was able to implement a 'standard look' that could help identify the troopers as Rebels and therefore also improve morale and unit cohesion. The large helmets with neck guards and khaki uniforms became some of the trademarks of the Rebel / [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] uniforms.

Rebel troopers of various units spread across the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] were often equipped with uniforms bearing a striking resemblance to the uniforms of the [[Alderaanian armed forces]]. Alliance sympathizers within the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] government helped fund, train and equip many militant groups outside the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]].<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Much of the uniforms and equipment came from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Planetary Security Forces]].<ref name="EG Warfare" />

[[File:Echo_Base_trooper_SWG_by_Ryan_barger.jpg|thumb|right|200px|An Echo Base trooper on Hoth]]
The Alderaanian-looking and most common uniform of the Rebel troopers consisted of blue shirts, black combat vests, gray trousers and black calf length [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. To protect [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and general infantry from head injuries, white blast helmets with blast visors and extended neck guards were issued as standard head-wear. They, however, lacked the level of [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]] utilized by their imperial counterparts. This basic uniform was seen all over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], often with smaller differences in design and coloring.

Troopers who operated in more harsh environments such as hot deserts, icy plains or thick jungles, would often be equipped with more specialized uniforms and equipment. Usually these troopers wore camouflaged uniforms. The most noticeable use of these camouflaged uniforms was during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], where rebel soldiers wore green/brown camouflage, to allow them to blend in with [[Endor/Legends|Endor's]] forested environment. On ice or snow planets, such as [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], they wore thicker, [[Color/Legends|white]] variants which afforded troopers greater protection from the elements.<ref name="BF I" />

[[File:Rebel_Heavy_FiB.png|thumb|left|180px|A heavy weapons specialist with high-powered blaster rifle]]
With the establishment of the New Republic, the troopers, now part of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic]], were more frequently seen wearing government and unit symbols on their sleeves and body armor.

With regards to weaponry, most rebel troopers were issued [[DH-17 blaster rifle/Legends|DH-17 blaster rifles]]<ref name="BF I" /> or [[A280 blaster rifle/Legends|A280 blaster rifles]]. These rapid-fire blasters made rebel troopers an effective fighting force in medium range combat. The two standard-issue sidearms were the [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]] and the [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]]. These pistols were usually only used when rifle ammunition was low or in close-quarter firefights, where a rifle would prove to be too cumbersome. Each trooper also usually carried up to 4 [[Class-A thermal detonator/Legends|Class-A thermal detonators]], for anti-personnel and anti-armor purposes.<ref name="BF guide" /> Although, these were not likely to be used during combat aboard starships for fear of a hull breach. On the open battlefield they could also utilize a range of heavier weaponry, including [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blasters]], [[Mortar/Legends|mortars]],<ref name="SW:GB" /> and [[HH-15 projectile launcher|hand-held missile launchers]].<ref name="BF I" />

Rebel troopers were outfitted at Alliance Army [[Barracks/Legends|troop centers]] on various [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] and were divided into several ranks. Trooper Recruits had only light armor and weaponry, while Heavy Blaster Troopers had better weaponry and tougher armor. Armored Repeater Troopers were issued [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blasters]].<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Droidsrebeltroopers.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Rebel troopers wearing uniforms inspired by Ralph McQuarrie's concept art appeared in [[Droids (1986) 6|''Droids'' (1986) 6]].]]
Early Rebel trooper designs created for {{Film|IV}} by [[Ralph McQuarrie]]<ref name="SW Art RM">''[[Star Wars Art: Ralph McQuarrie]]''</ref> appeared in various later sources, including the [[1986]] comic [[Droids (1986) 6|''Droids'' 6]] which features two of the designs as part of an alternate retelling of the film.<ref name="Droids 6">[[Droids (1986) 6|''Droids'' (1986) 6]]</ref> One of those two designs, featuring a large domed helmet similar to the final version, was released as a [[2007]] action figure as part of the ''[[Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection]]''{{'s}} Ralph McQuarrie Signature Series.<ref name="Concept AF">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|pack=Rebel Trooper - R. McQuarrie Signature Series|altlink=https://www.banthaskull.com/photo_galleries/gallery/ph_30_60_concept_rebel_trooper}}</ref> The second design featuring a face-covering helmet also appeared in the [[1981]] [[Star Wars (1977) 61|''Star Wars'' 61]] comic, worn by a [[Unidentified Rebel sergeant (Arbra)|Rebel sergeant]] on [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]].<ref name="MC 61">[[Star Wars (1977) 61|''Star Wars'' (1977) 61]]</ref>

Helmets similar to those worn by Rebel troopers were worn by Old Republic [[Republic soldier|soldiers]] in [[3956 BBY]], such as [[Trask Ulgo]] and other [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] personnel serving on the ''[[Endar Spire]]''. The uniforms worn aboard [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] had a strong resemblance to the uniforms of [[Kota's Militia]] from around [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].

In ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]'', the standard troopers wear camouflage gear, while the [[Rebel Vanguard/Legends|Rebel vanguard division]] troopers wear [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] style clothes.
